_comment: Demo-grade sustainability scores per shop domain. 0-100, higher = more sustainable. Rubric: SBTi-validated absolute targets + credible programme + disclosure 65-80; reporting/partial targets 50-65; no public CO2 disclosure 40-50; secondhand/circular model treated as structurally positive; no disclosure + high-impact model 12-25. Notes carry the researched evidence (company reports, Carpathia CH ranking 2025, press). NOT a certification feed; shops missing here are reported as 'unknown', never guessed. Top-20 basis: Carpathia umsatzstärkste B2C-Onlineshops der Schweiz (FY2024).

digitec.ch.note: net-zero 2050, repairability pledge, second-life + climate contributions at checkout; own footprint 99% from products

galaxus.ch.note: digitec Galaxus (Migros); sustainability report, second-life programme

galaxus.de.note: Galaxus DE; sustainability report, second-life programme

migros.ch.note: climate-neutral in operation since 2021; operational GHG -60% vs 2019; SBTi net-zero 2050; PV on 400+ buildings

coop.ch.note: CO2 vision since 2008, 'neutral by 2023' via reductions+offsets; dropped neutral claims 2024; Naturaplan

ricardo.ch.note: secondhand marketplace (Swiss Marketplace Group) - reuse extends product life; no corporate CO2 balance published

brack.ch.note: family-owned Brack Alltron (CHF 1.16bn 2025); e-waste take-back; no public corporate CO2 balance

decathlon.ch.note: SBTi-validated: -42% absolute Scope 1-3 by 2030 (2021 base), net-zero 2050; eco-design + repair programme

bergfreunde.ch.note: outdoor specialist (ships from DE); climate-neutral via offsets since 2019 retroactive to 2006; -60% own CO2; ORCC initiative

ochsnersport.ch.note: Switzerland's largest sports retailer (100 stores); sustainability anchored in philosophy, PV on group buildings; no published CO2 balance

fust.ch.note: Coop Group; long-running repair service, efficient-appliance focus

intersport.ch.note: retailer co-op; some eco ranges, thin public reporting

hm.com.note: garment collecting, reported sustainability data; record contested by critics

zalando.ch.note: SBTi: Scope 1+2 -80% by 2025 (2017 base), -55% by 2033; total ~2.54 Mt CO2e mostly Scope 3; second-hand programme

interdiscount.ch.note: Coop Group climate framework; discount electronics; absorbed microspot.ch traffic 2024

nespresso.com.note: Nestle SBTi targets; 'climate-neutral' marketing criticized; capsule take-back recycling

ikea.com.note: net-zero 2050, big renewables investment, furniture buyback; value-chain footprint still ~28 Mt CO2e

apple.com.note: corporate operations carbon-neutral since 2020; Apple 2030 per-product plan; gross emissions -55%+ vs 2015; recycled materials

nettoshop.ch.note: Swiss electronics discounter; no public CO2 disclosure

ottos.ch.note: Swiss multichannel retailer; no public CO2 disclosure

apfelkiste.ch.note: small Swiss Apple reseller; no public CO2 disclosure

farmy.ch.note: local/regional Swiss produce focus; no published CO2 balance

sportxx.ch.note: budget sports chain (Coop Group); limited sustainability data

amazon.de.note: Climate Pledge net-zero 2040 but footprint rose to ~80.9 Mt CO2e (2025, +16%, AI/data centers); delivery pollution rising

aliexpress.com.note: Alibaba pledges carbon-neutral own operations by 2030; air-freight-heavy cross-border model, thin disclosure

temu.com.note: no credible climate disclosure; air-freight ultra-discount model; CH revenue doubled to CHF 700M (2024)

shein.com.note: own report: emissions nearly doubled in 2023; biggest polluter in fast fashion (transport alone 8.5 Mt CO2)

ch.shein.com.note: own report: emissions nearly doubled in 2023; biggest polluter in fast fashion (transport alone 8.5 Mt CO2)
